# Showcase Abomination — abomination — 576 points

*v1999.12.0*

## Abomination Infantry (2×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 4x Abomination Infantry
- Type: Bio, Infantry, Walking, Amphibian
- Points: 56
- Shaken: slow [-, -, flee] / Can't use weapons

- **To Hit**: Take Cover[Still][-2]
- **Terror**: [range=1][d6]
- **Fire Order**: If given additional tentacle weapons, they fire simultaneously with other weapons on regular Fire(s) order, not Fire(b) order

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-6 | Kill 1 model |
| 7-8 | Kill 1 model, Psychic damage[d6] |
| 9+ | Unit destroyed |
- If one model is killed remove half of the +1 future damage tokens and if killed by bleeding/poison, remove that bleeding/poison token

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 4+ | shaken |


### Abomination Infantry

- Equipment: 1x Multipurpose Gun, 1x Fog Grenade Mortar
- Assault: strength 1/1/1/1 (6+), deflection 1/0/0/0 (6+), damage d6-2, AP 2

- **Fog**: Double to-hit penalties in fog and ignore to-hit penalty for enemies in fog. (however does not ignore line of sight through fog hexes)

- **Bonus**: +100% strength and deflections versus shaken units
- **Cunning Assault**: [2]

#### Multipurpose Gun

- Range: 5, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6 Psychic, AP N/A
- **Multipurpose**: Has two settings. Scare and blow gun. Scare do the regular Psychic damage, used by Fire orders. Blow gun is used by Fire(b) orders and only effect shaken bio units. All other units are immune. However, if you manage to cause Psychic damage the unit gets an insane token, in addition to the normal effects of the Psychic damage table

#### Fog Grenade Mortar

- Range: 4, angle True/True/True/True, damage N/A, AP N/A
- **Cloud**: Place fog in a hex within normal range. Note: choose one hex per model firing this weapon. Uses Ammo as normal.
- **Ammo**: May start the game without ammo, but instead place fog in 4 different hexes within range 3 of this unit at start of game (part of setup)

## Giant Frog Riders (4×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 2x Giant Frog Rider
- Type: Bio, Cavalry, Walking, Frog, Amphibian
- Armor: 4/4/3/0
- Points: 36
- Shaken: slow [-, -, flee] / Can't use weapons

- **Resistance**: Poison[4]
- **Terror**: [range=1][d8]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| ---- | ------ |
| 2-3 | Bleed[4] |
| 4+ | kill 1 model |
- If one model is killed remove half of the +1 future damage tokens and if killed by bleeding/poison, remove that bleeding/poison token

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 6+ | shaken |


### Giant Frog Rider

- Equipment: 1x Frog Spit, 1x Mechanical Melee Contraption, 1x Insanity Contraption, 1x Frog Cavalry Armor, 1x Tentacle CrackleSpears
- Assault: strength 5/1/1/1 (6+), deflection 5/0/0/0 (6+), damage d6, AP 2

- **Fog**: Double to-hit penalties in fog and ignore to-hit penalty for enemies in fog. (however does not ignore line of sight through fog hexes)

- **Cunning Assault**: [3]
- **Bonus**: +100% strength and deflections versus shaken units; Improves assault if ammo is spend. You may spend one ammo in an assault, to increase the success of both assault strength and deflection to 4+ instead of 6+
- **Assault Extra Damage**: Poison[4][1 for 4]; Psychic. If assault in a hex with fog, each hit by this model does an d6 Psychic damage in addition to the regular damage. This ability does not stack with more spears.

#### Frog Spit

- Range: 1, angle True/True/False/False, damage N/A, AP N/A
- **Range Extra Damage**: Poison[4]
- **Ammo**: Always treated as loaded
- **Order**: Fire in both first and second gunnery phase independent of other weapons and orders

#### Insanity Contraption

- Range: 2, angle True/True/False/False, damage d6 Psychic, AP N/A
- **Insanity**: Only effects bio units which are already shaken. If you inflict damage with this weapon, the enemy unit gains an Insane token in addition to the regular effect of Psychic damage.
- **Ammo**: Track ammo separately from other ammo and start game with no ammo. When you use melee contraption in an assault, Load the insanity contraption with 4 ammo. This is the only way to load the weapon. Once it is loaded, you may spend one ammo in any gunnery phase to fire the weapon.
